# B&B Associates Creations

> Design-build kitchen and bathroom remodeling contractor for Montgomery County, Bucks County, and the Philadelphia Main Line, PA. Family-operated, based in Maple Glen (Ambler), PA. Free in-home consultation; itemized estimate before any contract; permits and inspections handled in scope.

## Business facts (NAP)

- Legal name: B&B Associates Creations LLC (public name: B&B Associates)
- Address: 1141 E Welsh Rd, Maple Glen, PA 19002 (Upper Dublin Township; Ambler postal area)
- Phone: 267-402-8758
- Email: bb3associates@gmail.com
- License: PA HIC #PA104189
- Website: https://www.bbassociatesco.com/
- Hours: Mon–Sat 8:00 am – 6:00 pm
- Design showroom: Ambler, PA — opening Winter 2026/2027 (not yet open)

## Services

- Luxury Kitchen Remodeling: https://www.bbassociatesco.com/services/luxury-kitchen-remodeling/
- Custom Bathroom Renovations: https://www.bbassociatesco.com/services/custom-bathroom-renovations/
- All services: https://www.bbassociatesco.com/services/

Scope: full custom kitchen renovations and full bathroom renovations (primary/master suites, hall baths, powder rooms). Design, materials, permits, and construction under one contract. No partial remodels or cabinet refacing.

## Service areas

- Montgomery County, PA — Ambler, Blue Bell, North Wales, Lower Gwynedd, Flourtown, Lansdale, Fort Washington, Horsham, Maple Glen
- Bucks County, PA — Newtown, Doylestown, New Hope, Yardley, Warminster, Warrington, Chalfont, Buckingham
- Philadelphia Main Line — Wayne, Villanova, Bryn Mawr, Gladwyne, Haverford, Ardmore, Berwyn, Devon

## Typical investment (2026, published on site)

- Kitchens: $55,000–$75,000 (same-footprint refresh), $75,000–$110,000 (layout changes), $110,000–$150,000+ (full custom; Main Line estates to $180,000+)
- Bathrooms: $38,000–$55,000 (hall bath), $55,000–$85,000 (primary bath), $85,000–$100,000+ (spa suite)
- Timeline: kitchens roughly 12–20 weeks including design and permits (4–10 weeks on site); most bathrooms 5–7 weeks of construction
